methods.name: reset(): void
methods.description: Resets all blanks to initial values.

events.name: tp-fill-blank-change
events.description: Fired in response to an input or change event from a blank; bubbles and crosses shadow boundaries. The detail contains a plain object of values and a FormData snapshot. For duplicate names, the object keeps the last value while FormData preserves all entries.

dependencies.name: tp-base
dependencies.summary: Shared base class for tp-* components.

dependencies.name: tp-blank
dependencies.summary: displays a text, SVG or image answer in a focusable blank.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-fill-blank>` element collects answers in text fields and rich-content blanks.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Answer choices in the example | Click a shape or drag it onto the blank to assign it. |
| Using the component | Type in editable fields, or use the answer choices provided by the surrounding exercise for closed blanks. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between the available controls. |
| Focused controls | Use each control’s standard keyboard interaction.  |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy under the pointer, or around the focused component, then open its help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
